evidence.detail: AncientGrudge detail_sql concatenates both_ids (winner + loser deck IDs) into a flat GROUP_CONCAT string
detail() loads deck IDs from GROUP_CONCAT and calls deck.load_decks with all IDs flattened — no pairing between your deck and opponent's deck
renders a livedecktable for all detail decks — both decks shown as flat list with no visual connection between them
BurningVengeance also uses both_ids pattern for the copier achievement

triage.notes: Issue text itself asks 'A simple deck table may not be the right display for these?' — the display problem is confirmed but the correct UX is unresolved. Requires a product decision on how to visually pair the two decks before any implementation can proceed.
